data_gaps.reason: No clause on the pages states whether a downward revision is prohibited when the share price is below net asset value.
The pages state that shareholders holding the convertible bonds shall abstain from voting at the shareholders' meeting, but do not state whether bondholders must abstain in a bondholders' meeting.
No clause on the pages states a net asset value floor for the downward revision of the conversion price.
No clause on the pages states a par value floor for the downward revision of the conversion price.
The pages state approval by more than two-thirds of voting rights held by attending shareholders, but do not state the denominator base for that fraction.
The pages state approval by more than two-thirds of voting rights held by attending shareholders, but do not state the numerator as a count.
The pages state one exercise per interest year for the conditional put and one exercise for the additional put, but do not state an annual exercise limit in the requested form.
The pages state a continuous 30 trading day period for the conditional put, but the schema's put observation_window is not clearly established as a separate value.
The pages state at least 15 trading days for the down-revision and redemption triggers, but the conditional put clause states only a continuous 30 trading day period without a required-days count.

The pages describe adjustment-day treatment for conversion price adjustments and for the conditional redemption clause, but no clause specifically addressing adjustment-day treatment within the down-revision trigger observation window is stated.
No clause on the pages states whether a downward revision is prohibited when the share price is below net asset value.
The pages state that shareholders holding the convertible bonds shall abstain from voting at the shareholders' meeting, but do not state whether bondholders must abstain in a bondholders' meeting.
No clause on the pages states a net asset value floor for the downward revision of the conversion price.
No clause on the pages states a par value floor for the downward revision of the conversion price.
The pages state approval by more than two-thirds of voting rights held by attending shareholders, but do not state the denominator base for that fraction.
The pages state approval by more than two-thirds of voting rights held by attending shareholders, but do not state the numerator as a count.
The pages state one exercise per interest year for the conditional put and one exercise for the additional put, but do not state an annual exercise limit in the requested form.
The pages state a continuous 30 trading day period for the conditional put, but the schema's put observation_window is not clearly established as a separate value.
The pages state at least 15 trading days for the down-revision and redemption triggers, but the conditional put clause states only a continuous 30 trading day period without a required-days count.
The pages provide the accrued interest formula for redemption, but do not state a separate accrued-interest redemption rule in the requested form.
The pages state redemption within five trading days after maturity, but do not state the window as an integer number of days.
The pages state a continuous 30 trading day period for conditional redemption, but the schema's redemption observation_window is not clearly established as a separate value.
The pages state at least 15 trading days for the conditional redemption trigger, but the schema's redemption required_days is not clearly established as a separate value.
